name: dense-v1-authored-dev
label_policy: Assistant-authored English reading notes and bilingual questions. Evidence spans fixed before retrieval; all chunks containing a complete annotated span are relevant (binary). Other chunks are unjudged and scored as nonrelevant. Human review pending. Development smoke set, not held-out quality evidence.

questions.query: Which adaptation method keeps pretrained weights fixed and learns a low-rank update?

evidence.text: LoRA freezes the pretrained weights and trains low-rank matrices for weight updates.

questions.query: Какой метод адаптации замораживает исходные веса и обучает низкоранговое обновление?

evidence.text: LoRA freezes the pretrained weights and trains low-rank matrices for weight updates.

questions.query: Which fine-tuning approach combines a four-bit frozen model with trainable adapters?

evidence.text: QLoRA trains low-rank adapters through a frozen base model stored in 4-bit precision.

questions.query: Какой подход к дообучению сочетает замороженную четырёхбитную модель с обучаемыми адаптерами?

evidence.text: QLoRA trains low-rank adapters through a frozen base model stored in 4-bit precision.

questions.query: How can an inference server avoid reserving contiguous memory for each growing key-value cache?

evidence.text: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in blocks that need not occupy contiguous physical memory.

questions.query: Как сервер инференса избегает выделения непрерывной области памяти под растущий KV-кеш?

evidence.text: PagedAttention stores the KV cache in blocks that need not occupy contiguous physical memory.

questions.query: Which exact attention algorithm reduces GPU memory traffic by processing tiles?

evidence.text: FlashAttention computes exact attention using tiling to reduce transfers between GPU memory levels.

questions.query: Какой алгоритм точного attention сокращает обмен с памятью GPU за счёт обработки блоками?

evidence.text: FlashAttention computes exact attention using tiling to reduce transfers between GPU memory levels.

questions.query: Which retriever independently encodes questions and passages for dot-product ranking?

evidence.text: DPR encodes questions and passages separately and ranks passages by the dot product of their vectors.
